scope: Reconstruct the released prefixed distribution, not unprefixed Composer/Mozart inputs. Vendor dependencies and Composer bootstrap are excluded.

output.hash_format: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw SHA256(file bytes) + LF for every file.

patches.reason: Preserve the existing multisite creation fix: options tables do not exist yet during wp_initialize_site.

release_source_only_owners.inc/Dependencies/Minify: Manual upstream vendor; raw package version is not established by the lock.
release_source_only_owners.inc/Dependencies/PathConverter: Manual upstream vendor; raw package version is not established by the lock.
release_source_only_owners.inc/Dependencies/Psr/Cache: No matching package in the lock; released Git blobs are the input pin.
release_source_only_owners.inc/Dependencies/Psr/SimpleCache: No matching package in the lock; released Git blobs are the input pin.

limits: Source commit pins the already-prefixed released dependency files, including manually vendored libraries. Lock records describe package provenance; they do not prove a raw Composer/Mozart reconstruction.
The ten unprefixed vendor packages and generated Composer bootstrap are not reconstructed by this tool. Their current lock and installed metadata remain shipped inputs.
The lock lists wp-media/wp-imagify-partner but no corresponding prefixed owner exists in this bundle.
Existing dependency license files and copyright/license headers remain included; only the two named readmes are omitted.
